name: kb_demonology_warlock
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's demonology raid list, as far as a rotation can say it: Curse of Recklessness on a mob that carries no curse, Corruption, Shadow Bolt as the filler (Searing Pain and Shadowburn on short fights) and Hellfire on three or more stacked mobs. Every row about the greater demon, the pet's Felstorm, Power Overwhelming, Health Funnel and the summon cooldowns is pet state, which the rotation cannot read (kb.unexpressed).

priorities.note: Moved after the AoE entry: the filler has no cooldown, so as a rule it would starve the AoE cast the KB lists after it.
